# Lumon Studios

Lumon Studios is a specialist web studio that builds course systems, sales funnels, websites, and automation infrastructure for coaches, consultants, and training organisations. Founded by Tobi, an Electrical & Electronics Engineer with 100+ course platform builds across Kajabi, Thinkific, Teachable, GoHighLevel, WordPress, and Webflow. The studio operates three distinct service tiers: Launch (first-time course creators), Scale (established coaches consolidating tools), and Enterprise (whitelabel builds for agencies and HR/L&D firms). Clients span the US, UK, Canada, and Australia.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.lumonstudio.xyz/): Overview of Lumon Studios' value proposition, service tiers, client logos, featured work, testimonials, and ideal client profile.
- [About](https://www.lumonstudio.xyz/about): Studio origin story, founding principles, team philosophy (small, senior, no handoffs), and track record (100+ builds, international clients, engineering background).
- [Contact](https://www.lumonstudio.xyz/contact): Contact form, 30-minute discovery call booking via Calendly, direct email (tobi@lumonstudiomail.com), LinkedIn, and response time commitment (one business day).

## Services

- [Lumon Launch](https://www.lumonstudio.xyz/launch): A professional website + course launch system for experts launching their first paid program. Includes course site, payment infrastructure (Stripe/PayPal), basic automation (email sequences, lead capture), and launch handoff. From $2,500, delivered in 14 days.
- [Lumon Scale](https://www.lumonstudio.xyz/scale): A premium website rebuild + full course system integration for established coaches at $10k+/month. Includes systems audit, CRM architecture (HubSpot, GoHighLevel), pipeline design, automation build, website upgrade (Webflow/WordPress), and zero-downtime migration. From $7,500, delivered in 6 weeks.
- [Lumon Enterprise](https://www.lumonstudio.xyz/enterprise): Whitelabel course systems and learning platforms for HR consultancies, L&D firms, and agencies. Full NDA and whitelabel agreement, source file delivery, no client-facing attribution. Projects from $10,000, retainers from $2,000/month.

## Blog & Resources

- [Blog](https://www.lumonstudio.xyz/blog): Articles on course systems, automation strategy, coaching business operations, and platform comparisons. Content managed via Sanity CMS.

## Key Business Facts

- Platforms built on: Kajabi, Thinkific, Teachable, GoHighLevel, Webflow, WordPress, and custom solutions.
- Target clients: Coaches, consultants, therapists, course creators, HR consulting firms, L&D consultancies, corporate training providers, coaching agencies, and digital marketing agencies.
- Differentiators: No junior handoffs, no offshore chains, the person you speak with builds your project. Full asset ownership — every account, file, and login belongs to the client.
- Capacity: Maximum three concurrent Enterprise engagements at any time.
- Contact email: tobi@lumonstudiomail.com
